description: gte-modernbert-base full fine-tune (lr 3e-5, 8 epochs, bs 16, max_len 256) on: 326 pool texts labeled by deepseek-v4.1-flash with the 20 v2 seeds + seed-derived guidelines (labeler dev acc 0.965 vs plain 0.895, seeded 0.945), 1,148 seed-steered synthetic EN/DE inputs whose intended label the same labeler confirmed, the 20 seeds, and the 200 dev gold examples x3. Dev estimate by 5-fold CV over dev with the identical recipe (dev fold held out): oof acc 0.965 torch / 0.950 int8 at 0.5 (vs 0.935 without dev in training). ONNX dynamic int8 per-channel. Threshold 0.5 (int8 oof flat 0.95 for 0.3-0.5).
